ProjectConfigurationRF

ProjectConfigurationRF.Rd

An object storing configuration used project-wide, composed of an esqlabsR project configuration and reporting-framework add-ons.

See also

Other project initialization: createAIPromptFromTask(), createAIWorkflowPrompt(), createProjectConfiguration(), exportWorkflowContext(), getQCpassedEnvironmentVariable(), initProject(), restoreProjectConfigurationRF(), setWorkflowOptions(), snapshotProjectConfigurationRF(), upgradeToReportingFramework(), validateWorkflowForAI()

ProjectConfigurationRF$getConfigSheetAsJson()

Get a configuration sheet as a JSON-friendly list structure. Reads an xlsx sheet and converts it to a list with column names and rows.

Usage

ProjectConfigurationRF$getConfigSheetAsJson(
  filePath,
  sheetName,
  convertHeaders = TRUE,
  skipDescriptionRow = FALSE
)

Arguments

filePath

A string representing the path to the xlsx file.

sheetName

A string representing the sheet name to read.

convertHeaders

Logical flag to convert header names (default: TRUE).

skipDescriptionRow

Logical flag to skip the description row (default: FALSE).

Returns

A named list with: - `column_names`: Character vector of column names - `rows`: List of rows, where each row is a list of character values

ProjectConfigurationRF$getConfigSheetsAsJson()

Get multiple configuration sheets as JSON-friendly list structures. Reads multiple xlsx sheets and converts them to named list format.

Usage

ProjectConfigurationRF$getConfigSheetsAsJson(
  filePath,
  sheetNames = NULL,
  convertHeaders = TRUE,
  skipDescriptionRow = FALSE
)

Arguments

filePath

A string representing the path to the xlsx file.

sheetNames

A character vector of sheet names to read. If NULL, reads all sheets.

convertHeaders

Logical flag to convert header names (default: TRUE).

skipDescriptionRow

Logical flag to skip the description row (default: FALSE).

Returns

A named list where each element corresponds to a sheet and contains the structure returned by `getConfigSheetAsJson()`.
